edits.after:
name: CDC independent parameter consumers

on:
  push:
    branches: [agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers]
  pull_request:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled]
    paths:
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/**'
      - 'morphruntime/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/**'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/**'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/**'
      - 'repro/cdc-independent-parameters/**'
      - '.github/workflows/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers.yml'
  # A commit-specific owner review can start this workflow while [skip ci]
  # continues to suppress the unrelated push/pull_request qualification fleet.
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Run the pinned source repair or normal targeted qualification
        type: choice
        options: [checks, source-repair]
        default: checks

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cdc-independent-consumers-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: '-Xmx2g -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
  JVM_OPTS: '-Xmx4g -Xss2m -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'

jobs:
  repair-reviewed-source:
    name: Pinned PR189 source-review repair and failed source gates
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'source-repair' && github.ref_name == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'labeled' && github.event.label.name == 'pr189-source-repair-v1' && github.event.pull_request.number == 189 && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.head_ref == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review' && github.event.action == 'submitted' && github.event.review.state == 'commented' && github.event.review.user.login == github.repository_owner && github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.event.pull_request.number == 189 && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'parameterized-verilog' && github.event.review.commit_id == github.event.pull_request.head.sha && github.event.review.body == format('pr189:source-repair:{0}', github.event.pull_request.head.sha))
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: true
      - name: Prepare only the pinned reviewed source metadata repair
        env:
          EXPECTED_INPUT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/pr189-source-repair"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_INPUT"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/input-identity.txt"
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/repair_source_reviews.py 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/prepare.log"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/candidate-identity.txt"
          git diff --binary "$EXPECTED_INPUT" HEAD > "$evidence/candidate.patch"
          git bundle create "$evidence/candidate.bundle" HEAD "^$EXPECTED_INPUT"
      - name: Execute the failed source gates and their rejection controls
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/pr189-source-repair"
          checks=(
            'git diff --check'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-native-source-overlay.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-58-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py --self-test'
            'bash morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-vec-boundary.sh'
            'python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_layering_root.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60g-source-scope.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-59h-inherited-source-scope.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-59c-inherited-source-scope.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --source-only'
          )
          failures=0
          index=0
          : > "$evidence/results.tsv"
          for check in "${checks[@]}"; do
            index=$((index + 1))
            printf '\nCHECK %s: %s\n' "$index" "$check"
            if bash -e -o pipefail -c "$check" > "$evidence/check-$index.log" 2>&1; then
              printf 'PASS\t%s\n' "$check" >> "$evidence/results.tsv"
            else
              failures=$((failures + 1))
              printf 'FAIL\t%s\n' "$check" >> "$evidence/results.tsv"
            fi
            cat "$evidence/check-$index.log"
          done
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
          printf 'Targeted source failures: %s\n' "$failures"
          test "$failures" -eq 0
      - name: Publish only a passing source candidate without launching full CI
        env:
          EXPECTED_INPUT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          branch='agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers'
          actual=$(git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/$branch" | cut -f1)
          test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_INPUT"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_INPUT" HEAD
          # Every new commit contains [skip ci]. No force push, target update,
          # automatic merge, or full-workflow dispatch is permitted here.
          for commit in $(git rev-list "$EXPECTED_INPUT..HEAD"); do
            git show -s --format=%B "$commit" | grep -F '[skip ci]'
          done
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr189-source-repair/published-head.txt"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pr189-targeted-source-repair-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pr189-source-repair/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  source-preflight:
    name: Current-head source audit preflight
    if: >-
      (github.event_name != 'pull_request_review' && (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.mode != 'source-repair') && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.action != 'labeled' || github.event.label.name == 'pr189-targeted-ci-v1')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review' && github.event.action == 'submitted' && github.event.review.state == 'commented' && github.event.review.user.login == github.repository_owner && github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.event.pull_request.number == 189 && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'parameterized-verilog' && github.event.review.commit_id == github.event.pull_request.head.sha && github.event.review.body == format('pr189:checks:{0}', github.event.pull_request.head.sha))
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Collect every current-source audit failure before expensive jobs
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="${RUNNER_TEMP:?}/cdc-source-evidence"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee "$evidence/head.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/tree.txt"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor 27af65abbee0d2334d6be7a6e4e2408b8af32fd9 HEAD
          checks=(
            'git diff --check'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-native-source-overlay.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-58-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py --self-test'
            'bash morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-vec-boundary.sh'
            'python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_layering_root.py'
          )
          failures=0
          index=0
          : > "$evidence/results.tsv"
          for check in "${checks[@]}"; do
            index=$((index + 1))
            printf '\nCHECK %s: %s\n' "$index" "$check"
            if bash -e -o pipefail -c "$check" > "$evidence/check-$index.log" 2>&1; then
              printf 'PASS\t%s\n' "$check" >> "$evidence/results.tsv"
            else
              failures=$((failures + 1))
              printf 'FAIL\t%s\n' "$check" >> "$evidence/results.tsv"
            fi
            cat "$evidence/check-$index.log"
          done
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
          printf 'Current-source audit failures: %s\n' "$failures"
          test "$failures" -eq 0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cdc-current-source-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cdc-source-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  baseline-probe:
    name: Historical baseline reproduction (448dfdf; not feature qualification)
    needs: source-preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 448dfdf29839bfde4f8ff1f4833f3bb01180a56d
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reproduce historical diagnostics on the exact historical source
        env:
          EVENT_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p cdc-independent-evidence
          printf '%s\n' "$EVENT_HEAD" > cdc-independent-evidence/event-head.txt
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee cdc-independent-evidence/head.txt
          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > cdc-independent-evidence/tree.txt
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 448dfdf29839bfde4f8ff1f4833f3bb01180a56d
          git merge-base --is-ancestor 7f355a859e7e88ca343e1ff82f261fb47b3311d0 HEAD
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py
          git diff --exit-code 7f355a859e7e88ca343e1ff82f261fb47b3311d0 -- core morphruntime morphhdl frontend \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py' \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/contracts/increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.json' \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/contracts/increment-54-typed-layering-ir.contract' \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py'
          python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_source_review.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py
          python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_layering_root.py
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain CdcIndependentParametersRepro /tmp/cdc-pr188-repro' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-independent-evidence/baseline.log
          python3 check_baseline.py ../../cdc-independent-evidence/baseline.log
          cp -a /tmp/cdc-pr188-repro ../../cdc-independent-evidence/baseline-rtl
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cdc-historical-baseline-448dfdf-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: cdc-independent-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  record-consumers:
    name: Current-head ports, BlackBox and UInt consumers
    needs: source-preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Authenticate the actual compiler head and record tools
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p cdc-consumer-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/head.txt
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/tree.txt
          java -version 2>&1 | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/java-version.txt
          iverilog -V > cdc-consumer-evidence/iverilog-version.txt 2>&1
          yosys -V | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/yosys-version.txt
      - id: generate
        name: Require successful native generation twice with both plugins
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain spinal.core.CdcConsumerSuccess out-consumers' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/generation.log
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain spinal.core.CdcConsumerSuccess out-consumers-repeat' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/repeat.log
          cat out-consumers/BlackBox/CdcRecordBlackBox.v
          cat out-consumers/Value/CdcRecordValue.v
      - name: Same-artifact independent override simulation and synthesis
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.generate.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          python3 check_consumers.py out-consumers out-consumers-repeat ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/simulation 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/override-matrix.log
      - name: Exact construction-side rejection diagnostics
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.generate.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain spinal.core.CdcConsumerSafety safety-consumers' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/safety.log
      - name: Tracked source remains unchanged by validation
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cdc-record-consumers-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: |
            cdc-consumer-evidence/
            repro/cdc-independent-parameters/out-consumers/
            repro/cdc-independent-parameters/out-consumers-repeat/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

# Source-repair success is not compiler qualification. Record-consumer success
# is not PR189 completion: compact timeout and mixed-validity tests remain open.

name: CDC wire-expression fixed point

on:
  push:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog, agent/wa-cdc-wire-01-fixed-point]
    paths:
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/**'
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/NativeWidthProvenance.scala'
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/ParameterizedExpressionCarrier.scala'
      - 'core/src/test/scala/spinal/core/internals/**'
      - 'lib/src/main/scala/spinal/lib/Utils.scala'
      - 'morphhdl-passes/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/spinal/core/**'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/**'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/cdc-wire-fixed-point.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog]
    paths:
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/**'
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/NativeWidthProvenance.scala'
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/ParameterizedExpressionCarrier.scala'
      - 'core/src/test/scala/spinal/core/internals/**'
      - 'lib/src/main/scala/spinal/lib/Utils.scala'
      - 'morphhdl-passes/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/spinal/core/**'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/**'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/cdc-wire-fixed-point.yml'
  # Repair commits use [skip ci] and explicitly dispatch this workflow (or the
  # other failed workflow) at the new head before requesting the full PR suite.
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cdc-wire-fixed-point-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  focused:
    name: Recursive cleanup, receiver safety and HDL equivalence Scala ${{ matrix.scala }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 75
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala: ['2.12.18', '2.13.12']
    env:
      SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
      JVM_OPTS: '-Xmx5G -Xss4M -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.sbt
            ~/.cache/coursier
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cdc-wire-${{ matrix.scala }}-${{ hashFiles('**/build.sbt', 'project/**') }}
      - name: Record exact source and install HDL tools
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/source.txt"
          printf '%s\n' '${{ matrix.scala }}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/scala-version.txt"
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends iverilog yosys
          java -version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/java-version.txt" 2>&1
          iverilog -V > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/iverilog-version.txt" 2>&1
          yosys -V > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/yosys-version.txt"
      - name: Authenticate current native source and reviewed overlay
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-cdc-wire-source-review.py --self-test 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/current-source.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/native-source.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/source-overlay.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-cdc-wire-regressions.py --self-test 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/report-controls.log"
      - name: Fixed-point regression and inherited emitter receiver safety
        id: regression
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sbt -batch '++${{ matrix.scala }}' \
            'core/Test/testOnly spinal.core.internals.VerilogEmitterExpressionInliningTests spinal.core.internals.NativePureExpressionCopyTests spinal.core.internals.SequentialWireEmitterTests' \
            'morph/Test/testOnly morphhdl.CdcWireCleanupRegressionTests morphhdl.CdcWireEmitterNamespaceTests spinal.core.internals.NativeWidthPublicationSafetyTests morphhdl.SequentialWireNativeTests morphhdl.examples.SequentialWireRetentionTests morphhdl.LaneWhenInliningRegressionTests morphhdl.examples.NativeWireExpressionCodecTests spinal.core.MorphVerilogExpressionInliningTests spinal.core.BooleanWidthNormalizationTests' \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/regressions.log"
      - name: Generate enabled, disabled and deterministic-repeat RTL
        id: generation
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.regression.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sbt -batch '++${{ matrix.scala }}' \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.examples.CdcWireCleanupArtifactWriter $RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/rtl" \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.examples.CdcPublicationCleanupArtifactWriter $RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/publication" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/generation.log"
      - name: Verify cleanup shape, four-state semantics and formal equivalence
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.generation.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl-passes/scripts/check-cdc-wire-cleanup.py \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/rtl" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/qualification.log"
          python3 morphhdl-passes/scripts/check-cdc-publication-cleanup.py \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/publication" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cdc-wire-evidence/publication-qualification.log"
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          # Stable per-lane names let a failed-job rerun reuse the successful
          # other lane's evidence from this same source and workflow run.
          name: cdc-wire-fixed-point-${{ matrix.scala }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cdc-wire-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30

  cross-scala:
    name: Cross-Scala deterministic CDC wire artifacts
    needs: focused
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Require both current-source qualification lanes
        run: test '${{ needs.focused.result }}' = success
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cdc-wire-fixed-point-2.12.18-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cdc-wire-cross-scala/2.12.18
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:

          import hashlib, json, os, re
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path(os.environ['EVIDENCE_ROOT'])
          versions = ('2.12.18', '2.13.12')
          tops = ('CdcSliceCompareRepro', 'CdcGrayChainRepro',
                  'CdcWhenPredicateRepro', 'CdcWireControls')
          modes = ('enabled', 'disabled', 'repeat')
          expected = {mode + '/' + top + '.v' for mode in modes for top in tops}
          identities, manifests = {}, {}
          for version in versions:
              lane = root/version
              identity = (lane/'source.txt').read_text().splitlines()
              assert len(identity) == 2 and all(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', item) for item in identity), 'invalid source identity'
              assert identity[0] == os.environ['EXPECTED_HEAD'], 'stale source evidence'
              assert (lane/'scala-version.txt').read_text().strip() == version, 'wrong Scala lane'
              identities[version] = identity
              rtl = lane/'rtl'
              files = {str(path.relative_to(rtl)) for mode in modes for path in (rtl/mode).rglob('*.v')}
              assert files == expected, ('missing or unexpected Verilog artifacts', version, files)
              manifests[version] = {}
              for relative in sorted(expected):
                  path = rtl/relative
                  assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), ('missing or linked RTL', relative)
                  manifests[version][relative] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              qualification = json.loads((rtl/'qualification.json').read_text())
              assert len(qualification['matrix']) == 14 and all(case['four_state'] == 'passed' and case['formal'] == 'passed' for case in qualification['matrix']), 'incomplete lane qualification'
              assert len(qualification['mutations']) == 2 and all(case['four_state'] == 'rejected' and case['formal'] == 'rejected' for case in qualification['mutations']), 'missing mutation rejection'
          assert identities[versions[0]] == identities[versions[1]], 'cross-Scala source trees differ'
          for relative in sorted(expected):
              assert (root/versions[0]/'rtl'/relative).read_bytes() == (root/versions[1]/'rtl'/relative).read_bytes(), ('cross-Scala Verilog mismatch', relative)
          publication_files = None
          for version in versions:
              publication = root/version/'publication'
              result = json.loads((publication/'publication-qualification.json').read_text())
              assert {(c['fixture'], c['depth']) for c in result['matrix']} == {(f, d) for f in ('fill','naming','hierarchy') for d in (2,3,4,8,16)}
              assert len(result['mutations']) == 2 and all(c['four_state'] == c['formal'] == 'rejected' for c in result['mutations'])
              assert len(result['matrix']) == 15 and all(c['four_state'] == c['equivalence'] == c['oracle_formal'] == 'passed' for c in result['matrix'])
              files = {str(p.relative_to(publication)) for f in ('fill','naming','hierarchy') for m in ('on','off','repeat') for p in (publication/(f+'-'+m)).glob('*.v')}
              assert all(any(p.startswith(f+'-'+m+'/') for p in files) for f in ('fill','naming','hierarchy') for m in ('on','off','repeat'))
              if publication_files is None: publication_files = files
              assert files == publication_files
              for f in ('fill','naming','hierarchy'):
                  proof = json.loads((publication/(f+'-on')/'fixed-point.json').read_text())
                  assert proof['second_invocation_changes'] == 0
          for relative in sorted(publication_files):
              assert (root/versions[0]/'publication'/relative).read_bytes() == (root/versions[1]/'publication'/relative).read_bytes(), ('cross-Scala publication mismatch', relative)
          report = {'head': os.environ['EXPECTED_HEAD'], 'tree': identities[versions[0]][1],
                    'scala_versions': list(versions), 'compared_verilog_files': len(expected),
                    'byte_identical': True, 'sha256': manifests[versions[0]],
                    'publication_verilog_files': len(publication_files), 'publication_matrix_cases_per_lane': 15}
          (root/'cross-scala.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          print('CDC_WIRE_CROSS_SCALA_PASS files=' + str(len(expected)) + ' exact_source=true byte_identical=true')
          PY

                      len(set(case_names)) == count,
                      f"incomplete Increment 61 testcase identities: {name}")

          remaining = {

              for path in reports.glob("TEST-morphhdl.Increment61*.xml")
          }
          require(not remaining,
                  "unexpected Increment 61 suite report(s): " + str(sorted(remaining)))

              "suites": sorted(observed),

          fi

            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-artifacts.py regressions \
              . "$inherited_inventory"
          )

          python3 - "$inherited_inventory" "$successor_inventory" "$complete_inventory" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          import sys

          inherited_path, successor_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          inherited = json.loads(inherited_path.read_text())
          successor = json.loads(successor_path.read_text())
          morphhdl = inherited["morphhdl"]
          overlap = set(morphhdl["suites"]) & set(successor["suites"])
          if overlap:
              raise RuntimeError("Increment 61 suite overlaps inherited inventory: " + str(sorted(overlap)))
          morphhdl["tests"] += successor["tests"]
          morphhdl["suites"] = sorted(morphhdl["suites"] + successor["suites"])
          if morphhdl["skipped"] != 0 or successor["skipped"] != 0:
              raise RuntimeError("complete Increment 61 inventory contains skipped tests")
          output_path.write_text(json.dumps(inherited, indent=2) + "\n")
          total = sum(record["tests"] for record in inherited.values())
          print(f"60f + Increment 61 complete regressions: {total} non-skipped tests")
          PY
          if test -f morphhdl/contracts/increment-59i-production-successor.json; then
            python3 -B morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-59i-regression-inventory.py finish --output "$output"
          else
            # Add validated new suites back to the already checked old + Inc61
            # inventory. The original current-head XML is never edited.
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-pr190-pr189-source-sync.py \
              --combine-regressions "$complete_inventory" "$output/sequential-test-inventory.json"
          fi

concurrency:

  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  qualify:
    name: Compatibility and tools Scala ${{ matrix.scala }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala: ['2.12.18', '2.13.12']
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    env:
      SCALA_VERSION: ${{ matrix.scala }}
      COURSIER_REPOSITORIES: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2
      COURSIER_CACHE: /sbt/.cache/coursier/v1
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: '-Xmx5G -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=4'
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require exact reviewed source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test
      - name: Bootstrap pinned SBT
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61-compatibility"
          mkdir -p "$output"
          version=$(sed -n 's/^sbt.version=//p' project/build.properties)
          test "$version" = '1.10.0'
          curl --fail --location --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
            "https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/scala-sbt/sbt-launch/$version/sbt-launch-$version.jar" \
            -o "$output/sbt-launch.jar"
          printf '[repositories]\nlocal\nmaven-central: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2\n' > "$output/repositories"
      - name: Generate the complete per-component compatibility corpus
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61-compatibility"
          java -Xmx4G -Dsbt.log.noformat=true -Dsbt.supershell=false \
            -Dsbt.boot.directory=/sbt/.sbt/boot -Dsbt.global.base=/sbt/.sbt \
            -Dsbt.ivy.home=/sbt/.ivy2 -Duser.home=/sbt \
            -Dsbt.repository.config="$output/repositories" -Dsbt.override.build.repos=true \
            -jar "$output/sbt-launch.jar" "++$SCALA_VERSION" \
            'morph/Test/testOnly morphhdl.Increment61CompatibilityMatrixTests' \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.Increment61CompatibilityMatrixArtifacts $output/generated" \
            > "$output/sbt.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 300 "$output/sbt.log"; exit 1; }
      - name: Strict Verilog-2001 compile, lint and synthesis for every roadmap family
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61-compatibility"
          compatibility="$output/generated"
          while IFS=$'\t' read -r case_id generated_top tool_top support_file; do
            test -n "$case_id" && test -n "$generated_top" && test -n "$tool_top"
            directory="$compatibility/$case_id"
            list="$directory/$generated_top.lst"
            test -s "$list"
            mapfile -t relative_sources < "$list"
            test "${#relative_sources[@]}" -gt 0
            sources=()
            for relative in "${relative_sources[@]}"; do
              test "$relative" = "$(basename "$relative")"
              test -s "$directory/$relative"
              sources+=("$directory/$relative")
            done
            if [ "$support_file" != '-' ]; then
              test "$support_file" = "$(basename "$support_file")"
              test -s "$directory/$support_file"
              sources+=("$directory/$support_file")
            fi
            timeout 120 iverilog -g2001 -Wall -Wimplicit -s "$tool_top" \
              -o "$output/$case_id.vvp" "${sources[@]}" \
              > "$output/$case_id-iverilog.log" 2>&1
            timeout 120 verilator --lint-only --language 1364-2001 -Wall -Wno-fatal \
              --top-module "$tool_top" "${sources[@]}" \
              > "$output/$case_id-verilator.log" 2>&1
            timeout 180 yosys -Q -T -ql "$output/$case_id-yosys.log" -p "
              read_verilog -defer -noautowire ${sources[*]};
              hierarchy -check -simcheck -top $tool_top;
              synth -top $tool_top -flatten;
              check -assert;
              stat;
            "
          done < "$compatibility/cases.tsv"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$output/head.txt"
          find "$output/generated" -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > "$output/generated.sha256"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: increment-61-compatibility-${{ matrix.scala }}
          path: target/increment-61-compatibility
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  cross-scala:
    name: Cross-Scala compatibility publication bytes
    needs: qualify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: increment-61-compatibility-2.*
          path: target/increment-61-compatibility-cross
      - name: Compare complete generated corpora
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root=target/increment-61-compatibility-cross
          left="$root/increment-61-compatibility-2.12.18/generated"
          right="$root/increment-61-compatibility-2.13.12/generated"
          test -d "$left" && test -d "$right"
          diff -ru "$left" "$right" | tee "$root/cross-scala.diff"

            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --source-only
          ) | tee "$output/inherited.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py | tee "$output/native.log"

    needs: source

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:

    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    env:
      SCALA_VERSION: ${{ matrix.scala }}
      COURSIER_REPOSITORIES: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2
      COURSIER_CACHE: /sbt/.cache/coursier/v1
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: '-Xmx5G -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=4'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

            -o "$output/sbt-launch.jar"
          printf '[repositories]\nlocal\nmaven-central: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2\n' > "$output/repositories"

        shell: bash

          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"

          proc

          opt

          design -reset
          read_verilog -noautowire $combined
          chparam -set LEFT_WIDTH $left -set RIGHT_WIDTH $right Increment61Top
          hierarchy -check -top Increment61Top
          proc
          memory
          flatten
          opt
          rename Increment61Top gate
          design -stash gate
          design -reset
          design -copy-from gold -as gold gold
          design -copy-from gate -as gate gate
          equiv_make gold gate equiv
          prep -top equiv
          equiv_simple
          equiv_status -assert
          YOSYS
            yosys -q -s "$work.ys" > "$work.log"
          done
      - name: Exercise missing, duplicate and wrong-file publication controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"
          split="$output/generated-a/split"
          if iverilog -g2001 -s Increment61Top -o /dev/null "$split/Increment61Top.v" > "$output/missing.log" 2>&1; then
            echo 'missing child definition unexpectedly compiled' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          cat "$split/Increment61Leaf.v" "$split/Increment61Leaf.v" > "$output/duplicate-leaf.v"
          if iverilog -g2001 -s Increment61Top -o /dev/null "$output/duplicate-leaf.v" "$split/Increment61Top.v" > "$output/duplicate.log" 2>&1; then
            echo 'duplicate child definition unexpectedly compiled' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          python3 - "$split" "$output" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, shutil, sys
          split, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          expected = {"Increment61Leaf.v": "Increment61Leaf", "Increment61Top.v": "Increment61Top"}
          pattern = re.compile(r"(?m)^\s*module\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\b")
          def check(root):
              for name, module in expected.items():
                  found = pattern.findall((root / name).read_text())
                  if found != [module]:
                      raise RuntimeError((name, module, found))
          check(split)
          wrong = output / "wrong-file"
          wrong.mkdir()
          shutil.copyfile(split / "Increment61Leaf.v", wrong / "Increment61Top.v")
          shutil.copyfile(split / "Increment61Top.v", wrong / "Increment61Leaf.v")
          try:
              check(wrong)
          except RuntimeError as error:
              (output / "wrong-file.log").write_text(str(error) + "\n")
          else:
              raise RuntimeError("wrong-file publication mutation was not detected")
          PY
      - name: Record exact source inventory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$output/head.txt"
          find "$output/generated-a" -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > "$output/generated.sha256"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-publication-artifacts.py record \
            "$output" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$SCALA_VERSION" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: increment-61-diagnostics-${{ matrix.scala }}-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: target/increment-61
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload qualified publication only after every producer gate
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: success()
        with:
          name: increment-61-qualified-${{ matrix.scala }}
          path: |
            target/increment-61/generated-a
            target/increment-61/generated-b
            target/increment-61/head.txt
            target/increment-61/publication-proof.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          overwrite: true

  cross-scala:
    needs: publication
    name: Cross-Scala generated-byte determinism
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: increment-61-qualified-2.*
          path: target/increment-61-cross
      - name: Compare complete generated publication sets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root=target/increment-61-cross
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-publication-artifacts.py compare \
            "$root" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
            | tee target/increment-61-cross-proof.json
          left="$root/increment-61-qualified-2.12.18/generated-a"
          right="$root/increment-61-qualified-2.13.12/generated-a"
          test -d "$left" && test -d "$right"
          diff -ru "$left" "$right" | tee "$root/cross-scala.diff"

name: Independent parameter domains

on:
  push:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog, agent/independent-parameter-domain-composition]
  pull_request:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog]
    paths:
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/ElabInt.scala'
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/NativeSymbolicLegality.scala'
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/ComponentEmitterVerilog.scala'
      - 'morphruntime/**'
      - 'lib/src/main/scala/spinal/lib/Stream.scala'
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/Elaboration*.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/**'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/native-source-preservation.json'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/increment-54-typed-layering-ir.contract'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py'
      - 'frontend/**'
      - 'repro/independent-parameters/**'
      - '.github/workflows/independent-parameter-domains.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: independent-parameters-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: '-Xmx2g -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
  JVM_OPTS: '-Xmx4g -Xss2m -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'

jobs:
  source-contracts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Verify exact source and negative authority controls
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="${RUNNER_TEMP:?}/independent-parameter-source-evidence"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee "$evidence/head.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
          git diff --check
          audit_root="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          if [[ "${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}}" == agent/increment-61-one-file-per-component ]]; then
            # Authenticate every current publication change before replaying
            # the unchanged PR-188 contract at the exact integrated target.
            # All other source controls and dynamic jobs use the current head.
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/increment-61-source.log"
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test 2>&1 | tee -a "$evidence/increment-61-source.log"
            integrated=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("morphhdl/contracts/increment-61-source-review.json"))["integrated_target_commit"])')
            test "$integrated" = 7f355a859e7e88ca343e1ff82f261fb47b3311d0
            git merge-base --is-ancestor "$integrated" HEAD
            printf '%s\n' "$integrated" > "$evidence/inherited-source-head.txt"
            audit_root=$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/increment-61-independent-source.XXXXXX")
            git worktree add --detach "$audit_root" "$integrated"
            trap 'git worktree remove --force "$audit_root"' EXIT
          fi
          (cd "$audit_root"; python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py) 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/source-overlay-live.log"
          (cd "$audit_root"; python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py --self-test) 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/source-overlay-selftest.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/source-preservation-live.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py --self-test 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/source-preservation.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py --generate-template morphhdl/contracts/increment-55-native-change-review.json --output "$evidence/regenerated-native-manifest.json"
          cmp morphhdl/contracts/native-source-preservation.json "$evidence/regenerated-native-manifest.json"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-artifacts.py self-test 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/inherited-inventory-selftest.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/retirement-live.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py --self-test 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/retirement.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/typed-layering-live.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py --self-test 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/typed-layering.log"
          cd repro/independent-parameters
          python3 -m unittest -v test_check test_qualify test_layering test_symbolic_policy
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: independent-parameter-source-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/independent-parameter-source-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error

  clean-regressions:
    needs: source-contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala: ['2.12.18', '2.13.12']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
      - name: Verify pinned tools and clean source compilation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
          yosys -V
          yosys -V | grep -Eq '^Yosys 0\.41([ +]|$)'
          verilator --version
          iverilog -V
          java -version
          python3 repro/independent-parameters/qualify.py --scala '${{ matrix.scala }}'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: independent-parameter-regressions-${{ matrix.scala }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: |
            independent-parameter-evidence/
            target/independent-domains-*/
            morphhdl/target/test-reports/
            frontend/target/test-reports/
          if-no-files-found: error

  native-reproducer:
    needs: source-contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
      - name: Exact standalone reproducer and byte-for-byte publication
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p independent-parameter-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee independent-parameter-evidence/head.txt
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
          cd repro/independent-parameters
          test "$(cat project/build.properties)" = 'sbt.version=1.10.0'
          sbt -batch 'runMain repro.IndependentParameterRepro out' 2>&1 | tee ../../independent-parameter-evidence/generation.log
          sbt -batch 'runMain repro.IndependentParameterRepro out-repeat' 2>&1 | tee ../../independent-parameter-evidence/repeat.log
          cmp out/RecordWidth.v out-repeat/RecordWidth.v
          sha256sum out/RecordWidth.v out-repeat/RecordWidth.v | tee ../../independent-parameter-evidence/publication-sha256.txt
      - name: Same-artifact overrides, every bit, hierarchy, branches and legality
        run: |

            repro/independent-parameters/out-repeat/

permissions:

env:
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'

jobs:
  qualify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala: ['2.12.18', '2.13.12']
    env:
      SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
      JVM_OPTS: '-Xmx5G -Xss4M -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1
      - name: Install strict compile, four-state simulation, lint, and synthesis tools
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y iverilog verilator yosys
      - name: Independently rebuild the unchanged reported compiler baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          baseline="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-baseline"
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-evidence"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/candidate-identity.txt"
          git worktree add --detach "$baseline" 3b547ae5622ae212c17f6e67cc96924127a46a41
          for file in GenerateLaneExpressionExample LaneConditionCoverageExample LaneReceiverCoverageExample LaneInliningRegressionWriter; do
            cp "morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/$file.scala" "$baseline/morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/"
          done
          cd "$baseline"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/baseline-identity.txt"
          git diff --exit-code -- core/src/main lib/src/main idslplugin/src/main morphplugin/src/main morphhdl/src/main morphir/src/main morphruntime/src/main frontend/src/main backends/verilog/src/main paramrtl/src/main morphhdl-passes/src morphhdl-passes/examples
          sbt '++${{ matrix.scala }}' "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.LaneInliningRegressionWriter $evidence/before" 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/baseline-sbt.log"
      - name: Compile and test the actual current production source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-evidence"
          sbt '++${{ matrix.scala }}' \
            'core/Test/testOnly spinal.core.internals.VerilogEmitterExpressionInliningTests spinal.core.internals.VerilogDeclarationPolicyStorageTests' \
            'morph/Test/testOnly morphhdl.LaneWhenInliningRegressionTests spinal.core.MorphVerilogExpressionInliningTests morphhdl.examples.NativeWireExpressionCodecTests spinal.core.BooleanWidthNormalizationTests' \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.LaneInliningRegressionWriter $evidence/after" \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.GenerateLaneExpressionExample $evidence/plain" \
            "morph/Test/runMain spinal.core.internals.LaneExpressionTraceWriter $evidence/trace" \
            2>&1 | tee "$evidence/candidate-sbt.log"
          cmp "$evidence/plain/LaneExpressionExample.v" "$evidence/trace/rtl/LaneExpressionExample.v"
          cmp "$evidence/plain/LaneExpressionExample.v" "$evidence/after/first/default/lane/design.v"
      - name: Check final RTL, parameter widths, simulations, proofs, and real RTL mutations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-evidence"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-inlining.py \
            --before "$evidence/before" --after "$evidence/after" --output "$evidence/validation"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: lane-when-qualification-${{ matrix.scala }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/lane-when-evidence/

          retention-days: 14
  cross-scala:
    needs: qualify
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lane-when-qualification-2.12.18
          path: scala212
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lane-when-qualification-2.13.12
          path: scala213
      - name: Require identical exact source identities and all emitted artifacts
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmp scala212/candidate-identity.txt scala213/candidate-identity.txt
          cmp scala212/baseline-identity.txt scala213/baseline-identity.txt
          diff -ru scala212/before scala213/before
          diff -ru scala212/after scala213/after

  compatibility:
    name: Lane Binary source and concrete parity Scala ${{ matrix.scala_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 300
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala_version:
        - 2.12.18
        - 2.13.12
    steps:
    - name: Check out exact head with complete history
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        fetch-depth: 0
        submodules: recursive
    - name: Record and authenticate the exact qualification revision
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
        git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/source-identity.txt"
        test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-source-scope.py
    - name: Prove JVM compatibility with the selected upstream baseline
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          bash morphhdl/scripts/check-binary-compatibility.sh --scala-version "${{ matrix.scala_version }}"
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/prove-jvm-compatibility-with-the-selected-upstream-baseline.log"
      shell: bash
    - name: Prove MorphHDL report ABI against the exact prior increment
      shell: bash
      env:
        BASE_COMMIT: 7f355a859e7e88ca343e1ff82f261fb47b3311d0
        SCALA_VERSION: ${{ matrix.scala_version }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$BASE_COMMIT"
          test "$(git rev-parse --verify "$BASE_COMMIT^{commit}")" = "$BASE_COMMIT"
          compatibility_root="$(mktemp -d /tmp/morphhdl-report-abi.XXXXXX)"
          baseline_root="$compatibility_root/baseline"
          cleanup() {
            status=$?
            git worktree remove --force "$baseline_root" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            rm -rf -- "$compatibility_root"
            return "$status"
          }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          git worktree add --quiet --detach "$baseline_root" "$BASE_COMMIT"

          (
            cd "$baseline_root"
            sbt -batch "++$SCALA_VERSION" "morph / Compile / packageBin"
          )
          sbt -batch "++$SCALA_VERSION" "morph / Compile / packageBin"

          scala_binary="${SCALA_VERSION%.*}"
          artifact() {
            root=$1
            mapfile -t candidates < <(find \
              "$root/morphhdl/target/scala-$scala_binary" \
              -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.jar' \
              ! -name '*-tests.jar' ! -name '*-sources.jar' ! -name '*-javadoc.jar' \
              | LC_ALL=C sort)
            test "${#candidates[@]}" = 1
            printf '%s\n' "${candidates[0]}"
          }
          baseline_jar="$(artifact "$baseline_root")"

# MorphHDL project instructions

These instructions apply to the whole repository. A more specific `AGENTS.md`
may narrow them for its subtree. A direct user instruction for the current task
takes precedence.

## Targeted CI before full CI

For every increment, qualify repaired or newly affected source with targeted CI
before starting full CI. Local tests are useful repair evidence but are not a
substitute for remote qualification.

1. Publish a clean candidate commit and record its full SHA and tree SHA.
2. Determine the affected workflow set from changed source, tests, generated
   artifacts, manifests, formal registries, source-review contracts and prior CI
   failures. Record workflow IDs as well as paths; workflow names are not stable
   identities.
3. Launch each affected workflow with `workflow_dispatch` on the exact candidate
   branch. Do not duplicate an active or successful run for the same workflow and
   head SHA. Immediately create or re-enable the increment's hourly monitor as
   described below; do not wait for targeted CI to finish.
4. Treat a workflow as passing only after every applicable job and matrix lane is
   successful on the intended head. Enumerate all run, job, check and status pages;
   aggregate labels alone are insufficient. A skipped applicable job, missing
   lane, pending job, cancellation or old-head success is not passing evidence.
5. Start one applicable full-CI qualification only after all targeted workflows
   pass. Do not use repeated full-CI launches as a replacement for targeted repair
   qualification. Keep hourly monitoring enabled through full CI, merge and
   verified increment closure.

Rerunning an existing job preserves that run's original source SHA. Use a
specific-job or failed-job rerun only for an unchanged-source transient failure.
After any source, test, workflow, manifest, registry or review-contract repair,
publish the corrected source and dispatch a fresh run on the new head.

## Browserless targeted dispatch

Do not require the user to run GitHub CLI commands. Do not depend on browser UI,
a devbox or an external MCP server when repository write access is available.
Use the following launch order:

1. Use a connected GitHub `workflow_dispatch` operation when it is exposed.
2. Otherwise, use the standing authorization below to publish and trigger a new,
   increment-specific repository dispatcher.

### Standing authorization for a repository dispatcher

When direct dispatch is unavailable, the agent is authorized to create a narrowly
scoped controller on a dedicated non-target, non-feature control branch. This is
an ordinary implementation mechanism for targeted CI, not a request for separate
user confirmation. The controller may use the GitHub-hosted runner's automatic
`${{ github.token }}` to call the Actions workflow-dispatch REST endpoint.

The controller must:

- start from the current integration target and live outside the feature PR;
- use a unique branch and controller identity for the increment and candidate
  head; never repurpose a controller pinned to another increment, PR, branch or
  SHA;
- have an exact `push` branch filter plus path filters limited to its own workflow
  and reviewed controller files;
- request only `contents: read` and `actions: write` permissions;
- use no personal access token, extracted credential, browser session, default-
  branch change, feature-branch trigger modification or unrelated workflow edit;
- contain an explicit allowlist of repository, PR, base ref and SHA, candidate ref
  and SHA, workflow IDs, dispatch payloads and any permitted inputs;
- accept only `POST /repos/OWNER/REPO/actions/workflows/WORKFLOW_ID/dispatches`
  for allowlisted workflows, normally with the exact body
  `{"ref":"CANDIDATE_BRANCH"}`;
- validate the live PR, target and candidate identities, candidate tree, original
  failure evidence when applicable, and workflow definitions before making any
  dispatch;
- enumerate existing same-workflow, same-head `workflow_dispatch` runs and retain
  queued, running or successful runs instead of duplicating them;
- recheck identities between dispatches, fail closed on movement or unexpected
  data, use bounded timeouts, and write an auditable dispatch ledger;
- dispatch only the affected workflow set. It must not update source refs, rerun
  old heads, launch full CI, merge, cancel unrelated work or broaden triggers.

Before publishing the controller, inspect all workflows that can match a push to
its control branch. The controller push must launch only the intended controller;
if other substantive workflows would also run, choose a safe isolated route or
stop without dispatching. The controller-launch commit must not contain
`[skip ci]`, because that would suppress the controller itself. Keep controller
commits off the feature and integration branches.

After the controller starts, verify each resulting run has the expected workflow
ID, event `workflow_dispatch`, candidate branch and exact head SHA. The actor may
be `github-actions[bot]` because the controller uses the job token; this is
expected and is not by itself qualification evidence.

## Failure handling and publication

- Leave unrelated and still-running jobs intact for the next scheduled snapshot.
- For a genuine source failure, repair the generic cause, run proportional local
  tests, publish a clean checkpoint with `[skip ci]`, and dispatch only affected
  workflows on the corrected head.
- Preserve authoritative ancestry. Do not squash, rebase, force-push or qualify a
  different tree under an old result.
- Do not weaken tests, simulations, formal proofs, mutation controls, source
  reviews, timeouts or workflow matrices merely to obtain a pass.
- After targeted qualification, follow the increment's documented full-CI,
  completion, merge and post-merge suppression requirements.

## Hourly monitoring through increment closure

After launching targeted CI for any increment, immediately create or re-enable
one recurring monitor scheduled every hour (`RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY`). Reuse and update
an existing monitor for the same repository, increment and PR instead of creating
a duplicate. Verify that the scheduler reports it enabled; record the monitor ID
and its continuation checkpoint. Do not claim monitoring is active unless a real
scheduled task exists. If scheduling is unavailable, report that blocker rather
than promising background work.

The monitor's prompt and durable checkpoint must identify the repository,
increment, existing feature branch and PR, target branch, candidate SHA and tree,
affected workflow IDs, run links, current qualification phase and next action.
Refresh these records after repairs or phase changes. Preserve the latest direct
user restrictions, including a targeted-only instruction or an explicit CI pause;
the general flow here does not override them.

On each hourly invocation:

1. Read the live PR, source and target refs, checkpoint and current workflow runs.
   Take one bounded status snapshot, enumerating all relevant run/job/check/status
   pages and inspecting actual failed-job logs. Do not rapid-poll, duplicate work
   already in progress or cancel unrelated runs.
2. For failures, fix the underlying cause without weakening coverage, publish the
   repaired candidate with automatic CI suppressed, and launch only the failed
   or newly affected workflows on the corrected head. Apply the unchanged-source
   transient-rerun exception above only when it genuinely applies.
3. Repeat targeted repair and qualification until every applicable targeted gate
   passes on the intended candidate. Leave active runs for the next hourly check;
   successful unaffected runs on that same head must not be duplicated. Never
   reuse old-head success as qualification for repaired source.
4. When targeted qualification is complete, proceed to full CI and then merge
   under the requirements below. Continue monitoring both phases; a green targeted
   run, a green full-CI run or a merged PR alone is not increment closure.
5. Retain evidence and report meaningful failures, repairs, phase transitions or
   blockers. If nothing actionable changed, finish quietly. Keep the monitor
   enabled while the increment remains open, including while a blocker prevents
   progress, unless the user explicitly requests that monitoring stop.

## Full CI, merge and verified closure

1. Once all applicable targeted workflows pass, launch one full-CI qualification
   for the exact final candidate. Reuse an already active or successful applicable
   full qualification for that same head instead of duplicating it. Continue the
   hourly monitor until all applicable jobs, matrix lanes and completion gates
   pass; skipped, missing, pending, cancelled or old-head results are not passes.
2. If full CI fails, inspect the failed jobs, repair the cause, and return to
   targeted CI for the failed or newly affected workflows. Only after those gates
   pass on the repaired candidate may another full qualification begin. Do not
   repeatedly launch full CI to diagnose individual failures.
3. After full CI passes, verify the live PR head and target still match the
   qualified source and integration assumptions, and confirm all required
   reviews, proofs, retained evidence and increment completion gates. If either
   ref has moved, reconcile the change and requalify before merging; never merge
   an unqualified successor or bypass required checks.
4. Merge the qualified PR using a normal merge that preserves ancestry, with
   `[skip ci]` in the merge commit message to suppress duplicate post-merge push
   CI. Inspect the applicable event triggers before merging: commit-message skip
   instructions cover `push` and `pull_request`, not every event type. Use the
   repository's supported suppression for any other post-merge triggers; do not
   disable workflows, weaken protection or skip required pre-merge qualification.
   If safe suppression or an authorized merge capability is unavailable, retain
   the checkpoint, report the blocker and keep monitoring enabled. Verify the
   actual merge commit, target ancestry and post-merge suppression afterward.
5. Record the qualified head, full-CI evidence, merge commit and completion
   receipts. Mark the increment closed only after the PR is actually merged and
   all documented roadmap/completion obligations are satisfied. Then disable the
   increment's hourly monitor and record its stopped state. Do not disable it
   earlier merely because CI passed or the PR merged.

/** Exact native expression identities still owned by retained Vec operation
    * journals. Their witness ranges and carrier topology are publication
    * inputs, even when an expression could otherwise be emitted inline.
    * Inspect only the closed compiler-owned record types, never user objects.
    */
  private[spinal] def retainedOperationExpressions(component: Component): Vector[Expression] = {
    val visited = new IdentityHashMap[AnyRef, java.lang.Boolean]()
    val expressions = ArrayBuffer.empty[Expression]
    def once(value: AnyRef)(body: => Unit): Unit =
      if (visited.put(value, java.lang.Boolean.TRUE) == null) body
    def expression(value: Expression): Unit = once(value) {
      expressions += value
      value.foreachDrivingExpression(expression)
    }
    def record(value: Product): Unit = once(value.asInstanceOf[AnyRef]) {
      value.productIterator.foreach(collect)
    }
    def packedSupport(operation: ParameterizedVecPackedAssignment): Unit = {
      val traced = new IdentityHashMap[Expression, java.lang.Boolean]()
      def trace(value: Expression): Unit = {
        if (value == null || traced.put(value, java.lang.Boolean.TRUE) != null) return
        expression(value)
        value match {
          case anchor if (anchor eq operation.carrier) || (anchor eq operation.source) =>
          case access: BitsRangedAccessFixed => trace(access.source)
          case access: BitsBitAccessFixed => trace(access.source)
          case cast: CastBitsToUInt => trace(cast.input)
          case cast: CastBitsToSInt => trace(cast.input)
          case cast: CastBitsToEnum => trace(cast.input)
          case intermediate: BaseType if intermediate.isComb && intermediate.isDirectionLess &&
              !intermediate.isAnalog && (intermediate.component eq component) &&
              intermediate.hasOnlyOneStatement => intermediate.head match {
            case assignment: DataAssignmentStatement if (assignment.target eq intermediate) &&
                (assignment.parentScope eq component.dslBody) =>
              collect(assignment)
              trace(assignment.source)
            case _ =>
          }
          case _ =>
        }
      }
      operation.assignments.foreach(assignment => trace(assignment.source))
    }
    def collect(value: Any): Unit = value match {
      case null =>
      case value: Expression => expression(value)
      case value: Data => value.flatten.foreach(expression)
      case value: DataAssignmentStatement => once(value) {
        expression(value.target)
        expression(value.source)
      }
      case value: WhenStatement => expression(value.cond)
      case value: ParameterizedVecPackedAssignment =>
        record(value)
        packedSupport(value)
      case value: ParameterizedVecOperation => record(value.asInstanceOf[Product])
      case value: ParameterizedVecReadSelect => record(value)
      case value: ParameterizedVecWriteCondition => record(value)
      case value: ParameterizedVecDynamicWriteGuard => record(value)
      case value: ParameterizedVecWriteInvocation => record(value)
      case value: ParameterizedVecForwardedDynamicWriteGuard => record(value)
      case value: ParameterizedVecPackedSlice => record(value)
      case value: ParameterizedVecPackedSourceAlias => record(value)
      case value: Option[_] => value.foreach(collect)
      case value: scala.collection.Seq[_] => value.foreach(collect)
      case _ =>
    }
    retainedVectorsOf(component).foreach { vector =>
      operationsOf(vector).foreach(collect)
      writeInvocationsOf(vector).foreach(collect)
    }
    expressions.toVector
  }

/** Begin a certified shape substitution on an unused native clone. Native
    * Vec cloning may already have inspected its inherited concrete width;
    * only this fresh value may clear that construction observation. The
    * rollback restores exact metadata without projecting it to a live branch.
    */
  private[core] def beginFreshCloneWidthChange(data: BitVector): () => Unit = synchronized {
    require(data != null && data.isDirectionLess && !data.isReg && !data.isAnalog &&
      data.head == null && !data.globalData.nodeAreInferringWidth,
      "SPINAL-NATIVE-FRESH-CLONE-WIDTH: only unused construction-time native clones may change shape")
    val metadata = metadataOf(data)
    val fixed = data.fixedWidth
    val observed = data.widthWhenNotInferred
    val inferred = data.inferredWidth
    data.widthWhenNotInferred = -1
    data.inferredWidth = -1
    () => synchronized {
      data.fixedWidth = fixed
      data.widthWhenNotInferred = observed
      data.inferredWidth = inferred
      retained.remove(new RetainedWidthIdentityRef(data, null))
      metadata.foreach(value => retained.update(new RetainedWidthIdentityRef(data, queue), value))
    }
  }
